here: Our daughter was born at 26 weeks, under 800 grams. 94 days in the NICU. Everyone at church keeps saying 'God did this' but the nurses sat with her every single night and the neonatologist made calls I could never make. Do I thank God or them? Both? Leaving the nurses out feels wrong.

My dad had a stroke in March and the neurologist pulled the clot out inside the first hour. Now at every family dinner my aunt says 'praise God, it was a miracle.' Sorry but it was a skilled doctor and a CT scanner. Why do Christians hand God the credit for what people actually did?

I recieved a kidney transplant last year from a 19 year old who died in a motorbike crash. I'm alive because he died and because a team worked for eleven hours. Where exactly is God in that? Is it right for me to say God saved me when another family is still grieving their son?

I am farmer in Kerala. Last month cobra bite me in the paddy. My son take me on motorbike 40 km to hospital, they give antivenom and I live. Pastor say God protect me. Doctor say I am lucky I come fast. Whom I must thank?

my little brother had severe malaria last rainy season, he was convulsing. we prayed all night and in the morning took him to the clinic and they gave him injection and drip. he is fine now. grandma says it was the prayer, uncle says it was the medicine. can it be both?? what does the bible say

paramedic. pulled a 7 year old out of a reservoir in july, CPR for six minutes and she came back. her mum grabbed me and said 'God sent you.' I'm not religious and it felt strange. Was it me, or God? Does the Bible even deal with this

Five years cancer free this week. Chemo, radiation, a mastectomy, and literally hundreds of people praying for me. I honestly don't know how to think about who healed me. Does Scripture say God works through medicine, or apart from it?
If God gets the credit when the surgery goes well, does he get the blame when it goes wrong? Seems like heads God wins, tails the surgeon loses.

I'm a community pharmacist and I gave a lot of vaccines during covid. Some customers say 'thank God for science', some say 'thank God, not science.' Is a vaccine a gift from God, or just human cleverness? When it works, who is the thanks supposed to go to?

In my second year of uni I had a psychotic episode and spent three weeks on a psych ward. Medication and a very patient psychiatrist brought me back. My church friends say God healed my mind. Did He? Or was it the lithium? I don't want to be ungrateful to either.

I turned one hundred on Tuesday. Retired schoolmaster, I have outlived two wives and three of my doctors. My great-grandchildren asked me whom I ought to thank for my years, the Almighty or the tablets I take each morning. I should like a proper answer from Scripture, please.
my mummy says god made my arm better but the doctor put the cast on it. who made it better god or the doctor

pastor's kid here lol. my appendix burst at summer camp and I almost died of sepsis. my dad preached a whole sermon about God's miracle and didn't mention the surgeon once. it kinda bugs me. is it biblical to thank the doctors too or is that taking glory from God

I became a Christian a few months ago. Before that I was in a bad car crash, broken pelvis and three surgeries. People at my new church say God saved me back then, before I even believed in Him. Is that true? I always thought it was the trauma surgeons.
biochem student. if a recovery happens through mechanisms we fully understand (antibiotic kills the bacteria, done) where's the room for god to be 'the healer'? isnt that just god of the gaps

Had a heart attack on the golf course at 71. A stranger did CPR until the ambulance came with a defibrillator, then three stents. I've gone to church all my life and never really asked this: am I alive because of God or because of that stranger?

Good day po. I am nurse in burn unit here in Manila. When patient survive, family always say 'thanks God' and forget the staff. I am not angry but I wonder, in Bible does God use people to heal, or only by miracle?

My father was intubated 3 weeks for covid in Guadalajara. He survive, thanks God. We made a promise to God, and the doctors work day and night also. My cousin say only God saved him, the doctor say it was the ICU. I am confuse, who we should give the credit?
I'm an ICU nurse and I am so tired of families saying 'it was all God' after we've done 14 hour shifts keeping their mother alive. Does the Bible actually say we get zero credit??
who healed me god or the doctor

near.q: We did everything. Best oncologist in Johannesburg, two rounds of chemo, a trial drug. My wife still died at 44 and hundreds of people were praying. Why didn't God heal her when He could have?
near.asks: why God did not heal a wife who died despite every treatment

near.q: our baby boy lived 9 days in the NICU and the doctors tried everything they had. why does god let some babies live and not mine
near.asks: why God let a baby die when the doctors tried everything

near.q: My brother get the fever, we take him to district hospital, doctors try every medicine, still he die. Village people say it is God's will. Why God not heal him? He was good man and he pray every day.
near.asks: why God did not heal a brother who died despite treatment

near.q: My grandmother won't take her blood pressure pills because she says it would mean she doesn't trust God. Is she right?
near.asks: whether taking medicine means not trusting God

near.q: is it a sin to take antidepressants? my youth leader said i should just pray more and read my bible
near.asks: whether taking antidepressants shows a lack of faith

near.q: New Christian here. A man at church told me if I had real faith I would stop my insulin. That scares me. Is taking medicine a lack of faith?
near.asks: whether taking insulin is a lack of faith

near.q: SCAN CAME BACK CLEAR!!! how do i even thank God properly, im sitting in the hospital car park crying
near.asks: how to thank God after a clear scan

near.q: My son's biopsy came back benign this morning. I want to thank God with more than a quick prayer. How did people in the Bible give thanks after God brought them through?
near.asks: how to give thanks to God after good news

near.q: open heart surgery thursday. terrified i wont wake up
Next week I go under general anaesthetic for the first time and I haven't slept properly since they booked it. What does God say to someone who is this scared?
Tomorrow my mother have operation for brain tumor. I am very afraid for her. Please give me some word to hold on.
Do miraculous healings still happen today, or did they stop with the apostles? I have never seen one that couldn't be explained some other way.
my friend says at her church people get healed of cancer when they lay hands on them. does that really happen now??
I've looked after my dad with dementia for three years now. I'm exhausted and I feel guilty for resenting it sometimes.
near.asks: caring for a parent with dementia

near.q: My wife had a stroke two years ago and now I bathe her and feed her. I am 78 myself. Where do I find the strength to keep going?
